verdict.rationale: Jira is a SaaS work-tracking product, so an official CLI is a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents one. The MCP server, REST/OpenAPI APIs, and Forge dev-site provisioning are different capabilities or developer building blocks. Community-written API wrapper scripts are a user-side workaround and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
